title: Epidemiology, comorbidity profiles, and oral anticoagulation patterns among patients with atrial fibrillation in Turkey: a meta-analysis of national registry-based and multicenter observational studies.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a major public health burden globally, associated with increased risk of stroke and mortality. While real-world data on AF management have expanded globally, comprehensive syntheses from developing countries such as Turkey remain limited. The objective of this study was to systematically evaluates the epidemiological characteristics, comorbidity profiles, and patterns of oral anticoagulant (OAC) use among patients with AF in Turkey based on national registry-based and multicenter observational studies.

METHODS: A systematic search of PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Embase was conducted on 15 November 2025, and subsequently updated on 8 July 2026 to identify studies of Turkish AF patients. Included registries were conducted between 2013 and 2024. Data were extracted on demographics, clinical risk scores (CHA₂DS₂-VASc, HAS-BLED), comorbidities, AF type, and OAC patterns. Pooled estimates were calculated using random-effects meta-analyses with restricted maximum likelihood (REML) estimation and Knapp-Hartung adjustments.

RESULTS: Six registries comprising 18,219 Turkish AF patients were included. The pooled mean age was 69 years (95% CI: 66.9-71.2), with 58% (95% CI: 0.56-0.60) female representation. Hypertension (0.76, 95% CI: 0.71-0.80) and diabetes mellitus (0.25, 95% CI: 0.21-0.28) were the most common comorbidities. The mean CHA₂DS₂-VASc and HAS-BLED scores were 3.67 (95% CI: 2.99-4.35) and 1.72 (95% CI: 1.36-2.08), respectively, reflecting moderate-to-high thromboembolic risk and moderate bleeding risk. Persistent/permanent AF accounted for 0.73 (95% CI: 0.57-0.89) of cases, although the very high heterogeneity warrants caution. Because three registries enrolled patients on the basis of NOAC therapy by design, treatment-pattern estimates were stratified by registry type. Among all-comer registries, pooled NOAC use was 0.60 (95% CI: 0.20-0.90) and overall OAC use was 0.88 (95% CI: 0.49-0.98), whereas pooling all registries produced inflated estimates (NOAC 0.97, OAC 0.99); VKA use was correspondingly higher in all-comer registries (0.24, 95% CI: 0.10-0.47). Procedural interventions such as ablation (3%) and cardioversion (9%) remained infrequent.

CONCLUSIONS: This meta-analysis of registry-based and multicenter observational studies suggests progress in pharmacological stroke prevention among AF patients in Turkey, with greater NOAC use in later and all-comer registries. However, the low use of rhythm-control strategies and the substantial inter-registry heterogeneity indicate ongoing gaps in AF management that warrant cautious interpretation and system-level improvements.

AI.tldr: 土耳其6项注册研究共18,219例AF患者的荟萃分析显示，NOAC使用率在全体入组注册中约60%、总体OAC约88%，但消融（3%）与复律（9%）等节律控制措施使用率低。
AI.motivation: AF是全球卒中与死亡的重要负担，真实世界管理数据多来自发达国家，土耳其等发展中国家缺乏对AF流行病学、合并症谱及口服抗凝（OAC）模式的系统汇总，既往证据存在缺口。
AI.method: 系统检索PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Embase（2025年11月15日检索、2026年7月8日更新），纳入2013—2024年土耳其AF注册与多中心观察性研究；提取人口学、CHA₂DS₂-VASc与HAS-BLED评分、合并症、AF类型及OAC模式；采用随机效应模型（REML估计、Knapp-Hartung校正）计算合并估计值，并按注册类型分层分析治疗模式。
AI.conclusion: 土耳其AF患者卒中预防用药已有进步，较晚及全体入组注册中NOAC使用更多，但节律控制策略使用率低、注册间异质性大，提示AF管理仍存差距；因部分注册按NOAC设计入组，治疗模式估计需谨慎解读，需系统层面改进。

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）是全球主要的公共卫生负担，与卒中和死亡风险增加相关。尽管全球范围内关于AF管理的真实世界数据不断扩展，但来自土耳其等发展中国家的综合性汇总分析仍然有限。本研究旨在基于全国注册登记和多中心观察性研究，系统评估土耳其AF患者的流行病学特征、合并症概况及口服抗凝药（OAC）使用模式。

方法：于2025年11月15日对PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Embase进行系统检索，并于2026年7月8日更新，以识别关于土耳其AF患者的研究。纳入的注册登记研究实施于2013年至2024年间。提取了人口学特征、临床风险评分（CHA₂DS₂-VASc、HAS-BLED）、合并症、AF类型及OAC使用模式的数据。采用随机效应meta分析，使用限制性最大似然（REML）估计和Knapp-Hartung校正计算合并估计值。

结果：共纳入6项注册登记研究，包含18,219例土耳其AF患者。合并平均年龄为69岁（95% CI：66.9-71.2），女性占比为58%（95% CI：0.56-0.60）。高血压（0.76，95% CI：0.71-0.80）和糖尿病（0.25，95% CI：0.21-0.28）是最常见的合并症。平均CHA₂DS₂-VASc和HAS-BLED评分分别为3.67（95% CI：2.99-4.35）和1.72（95% CI：1.36-2.08），反映中高血栓栓塞风险和中度出血风险。持续性/永久性AF占0.73（95% CI：0.57-0.89），但极高的异质性需谨慎解读。由于三项注册登记研究在设计上以NOAC治疗为基础纳入患者，治疗模式估计值按注册登记类型进行分层。在全体患者注册登记中，合并NOAC使用率为0.60（95% CI：0.20-0.90），总体OAC使用率为0.88（95% CI：0.49-0.98），而合并所有注册登记研究则产生膨胀的估计值（NOAC 0.97，OAC 0.99）；相应地，VKA使用率在全体患者注册登记中更高（0.24，95% CI：0.10-0.47）。消融（3%）和心脏复律（9%）等介入操作仍然不常见。

结论：这项基于注册登记和多中心观察性研究的meta分析提示，土耳其AF患者在药物性卒中预防方面取得了进展，后期及全体患者注册登记中NOAC使用率更高。然而，节律控制策略使用率低以及注册登记间显著异质性表明AF管理仍存在差距，需谨慎解读并进行系统层面的改进。

title: Association between insulin resistance-related indices and the risk of recurrence after catheter ablation in patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Insulin resistance (IR) is closely associated with the development and recurrence of atrial fibrillation (AF). Several non-insulin-based surrogate markers of insulin resistance, including the triglyceride-glucose index (TyG), triglyceride-glucose-body mass index (TyG-BMI), metabolic score for insulin resistance (METS-IR), triglyceride-to-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio (TG/HDL-C), estimated glucose disposal rate (eGDR), and C-reactive protein-triglyceride-glucose index (CTI), can be calculated from routine clinical biomarkers. However, the value of these indices in predicting recurrence after catheter ablation for AF remains unclear. In particular, CTI, a novel marker integrating inflammatory and metabolic status, has not been fully explored for its potential role in predicting post-ablation AF recurrence. This study aimed to systematically evaluate the association and predictive performance of six insulin resistance surrogate markers for AF recurrence after catheter ablation.

METHODS: This retrospective two-center cohort study included 590 patients with nonvalvular AF who underwent first-time catheter ablation between January 2022 and March 2025. Six IR surrogate indices were calculated, and AF recurrence within 1 year was defined as the primary endpoint. Multivariable Cox regression, Kaplan-Meier analysis, restricted cubic spline (RCS) analysis, C-statistic, net reclassification improvement (NRI), and integrated discrimination improvement (IDI) were used to assess associations and predictive value.

RESULTS: During 1-year follow-up, 167 patients experienced recurrence (28.31%). Multivariable Cox analysis showed that lower eGDR and higher TyG, TyG-BMI, METS-IR, and CTI were associated with increased recurrence risk, with more stable associations observed for eGDR, TyG-BMI, METS-IR, and CTI. Kaplan-Meier and RCS analyses further supported stratified differences and exposure-response relationships for some indices. For predictive performance, eGDR showed the most favorable overall performance, while CTI, TyG-BMI, and METS-IR also provided incremental predictive value. TyG and TG/HDL-C showed relatively limited incremental value. After false discovery rate correction, subgroup analyses showed generally consistent results.

CONCLUSION: Among the six IR surrogate indices, eGDR, CTI, TyG-BMI, and METS-IR were associated with AF recurrence after catheter ablation. eGDR showed the most favorable overall predictive performance. These indices may serve as adjunctive markers for post-ablation recurrence risk stratification, although prospective validation is needed.

AI.tldr: 在非瓣膜性房颤首次消融患者中，eGDR、CTI、TyG-BMI和METS-IR与术后1年复发风险独立相关，其中eGDR预测性能最佳。
AI.motivation: 胰岛素抵抗与房颤发生及复发密切相关，基于常规生物标志物的六种非胰岛素胰岛素抵抗替代指标（TyG、TyG-BMI、METS-IR、TG/HDL-C、eGDR、CTI）对房颤消融术后复发的预测价值尚不明确，尤其CTI这一整合炎症与代谢状态的新指标研究不足。
AI.method: 回顾性双中心队列研究，纳入2022年1月至2025年3月首次接受导管消融的非瓣膜性房颤患者590例，计算六种胰岛素抵抗替代指标，主要终点为术后1年内房颤复发。采用多因素Cox回归、Kaplan-Meier分析、限制性立方样条（RCS）、C统计量、净重分类改善（NRI）和综合判别改善（IDI）评估关联与预测价值。
AI.result: 1年随访期间167例（28.31%）复发。多因素Cox分析显示，较低eGDR及较高TyG、TyG-BMI、METS-IR、CTI与复发风险增加相关，其中eGDR、TyG-BMI、METS-IR和CTI的关联更稳定。Kaplan-Meier和RCS分析进一步支持部分指标的分层差异和暴露-反应关系。预测性能方面，eGDR总体表现最佳，CTI、TyG-BMI和METS-IR也提供增量预测价值，TyG和TG/HDL-C增量价值相对有限。经错误发现率校正后，亚组分析结果基本一致。
AI.conclusion: 六种胰岛素抵抗替代指标中，eGDR、CTI、TyG-BMI和METS-IR与房颤消融术后复发相关，eGDR总体预测性能最佳。这些指标可作为术后复发风险分层的辅助标志物，但需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景：胰岛素抵抗（IR）与心房颤动（AF）的发生和复发密切相关。几种基于非胰岛素的胰岛素抵抗替代标志物，包括甘油三酯-葡萄糖指数（TyG）、甘油三酯-葡萄糖-体重指数（TyG-BMI）、胰岛素抵抗代谢评分（METS-IR）、甘油三酯与高密度脂蛋白胆固醇比值（TG/HDL-C）、估计葡萄糖处置率（eGDR）和C反应蛋白-甘油三酯-葡萄糖指数（CTI），可通过常规临床生物标志物计算。然而，这些指标在预测AF导管消融后复发方面的价值仍不清楚。特别是CTI，一种整合炎症和代谢状态的新型标志物，其在预测消融后AF复发中的潜在作用尚未被充分探索。本研究旨在系统评估六种胰岛素抵抗替代标志物与导管消融后AF复发的关联及预测性能。

方法：这项回顾性双中心队列研究纳入了2022年1月至2025年3月期间接受首次导管消融的590例非瓣膜性AF患者。计算了六种IR替代指数，并将1年内AF复发定义为主要终点。采用多变量Cox回归、Kaplan-Meier分析、限制性立方样条（RCS）分析、C统计量、净重分类改善（NRI）和综合判别改善（IDI）来评估关联和预测价值。

结果：在1年随访期间，167例患者出现复发（28.31%）。多变量Cox分析显示，较低的eGDR和较高的TyG、TyG-BMI、METS-IR和CTI与复发风险增加相关，其中eGDR、TyG-BMI、METS-IR和CTI的关联更为稳定。Kaplan-Meier和RCS分析进一步支持了某些指数的分层差异和暴露-反应关系。在预测性能方面，eGDR表现出最有利的总体性能，而CTI、TyG-BMI和METS-IR也提供了增量预测价值。TyG和TG/HDL-C的增量价值相对有限。经错误发现率校正后，亚组分析显示结果总体一致。

结论：在六种IR替代指数中，eGDR、CTI、TyG-BMI和METS-IR与导管消融后AF复发相关。eGDR表现出最有利的总体预测性能。这些指数可作为消融后复发风险分层的辅助标志物，但仍需前瞻性验证。

title: Source-Specific PM2.5 Exposure and Atrial Fibrillation Risk in U.S. Older Adults: A Nationwide Cohort Study
Nationwide assessment of early hospitalizations and mortality after pulsed field ablation
Left atrial appendage morphology and hemodynamics: potential new markers for individualized thromboembolic risk assessment in atrial fibrillation
Sudden cardiac arrest during diagnostic workup: a rare case of high-risk interarterial left anterior descending artery anomaly.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Coronary artery anomalies are anatomical abnormalities involving abnormal origin, course, or termination of any of the three main epicardial arteries. These abnormalities may go unnoticed during a person's lifetime; however, they can occasionally present acutely or chronically as angina, myocardial infarction, cardiac arrhythmias, or even sudden cardiac death.

CASE PRESENTATION: A 65-year-old woman with angina and stress-induced ST-segment depression in a treadmill test. Coronary angiography showed the absence of the left main coronary artery with separate origins of the left anterior descending artery and circumflex artery. During a planned cardiac computed tomography angiography scan, the patient presented with cardiac arrest secondary to ventricular fibrillation and was hospitalized. A high-risk interarterial course of the left anterior descending artery was identified, and coronary artery bypass grafting with surgical mobilization of the left anterior descending artery along its interarterial course, where it was ligated with a hemoclip prior to the first septal branch to prevent competitive flow. The postoperative course was uneventful.

CONCLUSIONS: When this rare anomaly is detected in the population, clinicians must identify the risk of fatal events and determine appropriate management based on age, symptoms, vascular anatomy, and the presence of arrhythmia.

AI.tldr: 65岁女性因心绞痛行负荷试验后，在冠脉CTA检查中发生室颤导致心脏骤停，确诊为左前降支动脉间走行高危异常，行搭桥手术并结扎近端分支后恢复良好。
AI.motivation: 冠状动脉异常是涉及三大心外膜动脉起源、走行或终止的解剖异常，多数无症状，但可表现为心绞痛、心肌梗死、心律失常甚至心脏性猝死。左前降支动脉间走行是罕见高危变异，临床识别和风险评估存在挑战，需明确管理策略。
AI.method: 病例报告。患者为65岁女性，因心绞痛及运动平板试验诱发的ST段压低行冠状动脉造影，显示左主干缺如，左前降支和回旋支分别起源。计划行心脏计算机断层扫描血管成像（CTA）期间发生室颤导致心脏骤停。
AI.result: 冠状动脉CTA识别出左前降支动脉间走行的高危异常。行冠状动脉旁路移植术，术中游离左前降支动脉间走行段，并在第一室间隔支前用hemoclip结扎以防止竞争性血流。术后病程平稳。摘要未报告随访时间及长期结局。
AI.conclusion: 对于罕见冠状动脉异常，临床医生需识别致命事件风险，并根据年龄、症状、血管解剖和心律失常情况制定个体化管理策略。该病例提示对高危解剖变异应积极干预，但病例报告局限性在于单例经验，需更多证据支持。

summary_zh:
背景：冠状动脉异常是涉及三大心外膜动脉中任何一支的起源、走行或终止异常的解剖学异常。这些异常可能在人的一生中未被发现；然而，它们偶尔可急性或慢性表现为心绞痛、心肌梗死、心律失常，甚至心源性猝死。

病例介绍：一名65岁女性，有心绞痛，平板运动试验显示应激诱发的ST段压低。冠状动脉造影显示左主干冠状动脉缺如，左前降支和回旋支分别起源。在计划的心脏计算机断层扫描血管造影检查期间，患者出现继发于心室颤动的心脏骤停并住院。发现左前降支存在高风险的动脉间走行，遂行冠状动脉旁路移植术，术中沿其动脉间走行对左前降支进行外科游离，并在第一室间隔支之前用hemoclip夹闭以防止竞争性血流。术后病程平稳。

结论：当在人群中检测到这种罕见异常时，临床医生必须识别致命事件的风险，并根据年龄、症状、血管解剖和心律失常的存在来确定适当的管理。

title: Cardiac MRI at 3.0T in the presence of implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs)
summary: Patients with implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs) often are excluded from receiving CMR scans at 3.0T due to ICD-induced image artifacts. This work aims to transfer sequence protocols established for CMR imaging in the presence of ICDs at 1.5T to a first human application at 3.0T. All measurements were performed on a clinical 3T MRI scanner. Phantom measurements were used to establish and optimize wideband PSIR LGE imaging at 3.0T. Volunteer measurements with externally placed ICDs were used for optimization of CINE imaging and wideband PSIR imaging. Thirdly, patients with implanted ICD were examined with the optimized protocols. Human measurements showed that SA stacks obtained with spoiled GRE after contrast agent showed a markedly lower artifact burden than the conventional approach. For scar imaging, a wideband PSIR with a bandwidth of 3kHz and a frequency offset of +750Hz allowed a sufficient suppression of relevant artifacts in the majority of scans. No strong correlation between the image quality and the distance between the cardiac silhouette and the device was detected. The presented work shows the feasibility of clinical cardiac MRI at 3.0T including GRE-CINE and wideband PSIR-LGE for patients with ICDs.

AI.tldr: 在3.0T临床磁共振上，采用宽频带PSIR LGE和扰相GRE CINE序列，可对植入ICD的患者完成心脏磁共振成像，多数扫描伪影得到充分抑制。
AI.motivation: 植入ICD的患者常因ICD所致图像伪影而被排除在3.0T心脏磁共振检查之外；本研究旨在将1.5T下已建立的ICD存在时的CMR序列方案转化至3.0T并完成首次人体应用。
AI.method: 可行性研究。在临床3T MRI扫描仪上依次进行：体模测量以建立并优化3.0T宽频带PSIR LGE成像；体外放置ICD的志愿者测量以优化CINE和宽频带PSIR成像；最后采用优化方案检查植入ICD的患者。摘要未报告样本量、终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: 人体测量显示，使用扰相GRE序列在对比剂后采集的SA堆栈图像伪影负荷明显低于常规方法。瘢痕成像采用带宽3kHz、频率偏移+750Hz的宽频带PSIR，在多数扫描中可充分抑制相关伪影。未发现图像质量与心脏轮廓至装置距离之间存在强相关性。摘要未报告效应量、95%置信区间及P值。
AI.conclusion: 本研究显示，对植入ICD的患者在3.0T下进行临床心脏MRI（包括GRE-CINE和宽频带PSIR-LGE）具有可行性。该方案有望扩展ICD患者接受3.0T CMR的适用范围，但摘要未报告样本量及统计比较，结论需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh: 植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）患者常因ICD导致的图像伪影而被排除在3.0T心脏磁共振（CMR）扫描之外。本研究旨在将1.5T下存在ICD时建立的CMR成像序列方案转化至3.0T的首次人体应用。所有测量均在临床3T MRI扫描仪上进行。体模测量用于建立和优化3.0T下的宽带PSIR LGE成像。使用外部放置ICD的志愿者测量用于优化CINE成像和宽带PSIR成像。第三，使用优化方案对植入ICD的患者进行检查。人体测量显示，使用对比剂后 spoiled GRE 获得的SA堆叠图像伪影负荷明显低于常规方法。对于瘢痕成像，带宽为3kHz、频率偏移为+750Hz的宽带PSIR在大多数扫描中允许充分抑制相关伪影。未检测到图像质量与心脏轮廓和设备之间距离的强相关性。本研究展示了在3.0T下对ICD患者进行临床心脏MRI的可行性，包括GRE-CINE和宽带PSIR-LGE。

title: Integrated proteomics and machine learning reveal AHNAK as a discriminative biomarker of atrial fibrillation in heart failure.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a frequent complication of heart failure (HF), markedly increasing morbidity and mortality. Although atrial fibrosis is increasingly recognized as a central mechanistic substrate linking HF to AF, the molecular determinants driving fibrotic remodeling and enabling early AF discrimination in HF remain poorly defined.

METHODS: We integrated label-free quantitative plasma proteomics with machine learning-based feature selection to analyze samples from 59 age- and sex-matched patients hospitalized with acute decompensated HF. Differentially expressed proteins were subjected to functional and pathway enrichment analyses, and candidate biomarkers were prioritized using an incremental feature selection framework. AHNAK, the top-ranked candidate, was functionally interrogated in vitro using TGF-β1-stimulated primary mouse atrial fibroblasts with siRNA-mediated knockdown and in vivo using a pressure overload-induced HF model in AHNAK heterozygous mice. A two-sample Mendelian randomization analysis was performed to evaluate the association between genetically proxied AHNAK expression and AF risk.

RESULTS: Plasma proteomic profiling identified 126 proteins that were significantly dysregulated in HF patients with AF compared with those in sinus rhythm, among which AHNAK was the most upregulated. Machine learning-based feature selection consistently ranked AHNAK as the most discriminative protein, with robust performance for AF discrimination in HF patients (AUC = 0.897, 95% confidence interval: 0.82-0.97). Functionally, AHNAK heterozygous deficiency promoted a profibrotic phenotype, characterized by increased expression of α-smooth muscle actin, fibronectin, and collagen Iα in atrial fibroblasts and exacerbated atrial fibrosis and cardiac dysfunction in pressure-overloaded mice. Mendelian randomization analysis demonstrated a significant protective effect of higher AHNAK expression against AF, with no evidence of horizontal pleiotropy.

CONCLUSIONS: This study identifies AHNAK as a discriminative plasma biomarker for AF in HF patients and implicates AHNAK deficiency as a contributor to atrial fibrotic remodeling and AF pathogenesis. External validation in larger and prospective HF cohorts will be required to confirm the clinical utility of AHNAK for AF risk stratification and early detection.

summary_zh:
背景：心房颤动（AF）是心力衰竭（HF）的常见并发症，显著增加发病率和死亡率。尽管心房纤维化日益被认为是连接HF与AF的核心机制性基质，但驱动纤维化重构并能在HF中实现早期AF识别的分子决定因素仍不明确。

方法：我们整合了非标记定量血浆蛋白质组学与基于机器学习的特征选择，分析了59例年龄和性别匹配的急性失代偿性HF住院患者的样本。对差异表达蛋白进行功能和通路富集分析，并使用增量特征选择框架对候选生物标志物进行优先级排序。排名最高的候选蛋白AHNAK在体外使用TGF-β1刺激的原代小鼠心房成纤维细胞通过siRNA介导的敲低进行功能验证，并在体内使用AHNAK杂合小鼠的压力超负荷诱导HF模型进行验证。进行了两样本孟德尔随机化分析，以评估遗传代理的AHNAK表达与AF风险之间的关联。

结果：血浆蛋白质组学分析鉴定出126种在伴有AF的HF患者中与窦性心律患者相比显著失调的蛋白质，其中AHNAK上调最为显著。基于机器学习的特征选择一致将AHNAK列为最具区分性的蛋白质，在HF患者中区分AF具有稳健的性能（AUC = 0.897，95%置信区间：0.82-0.97）。在功能上，AHNAK杂合缺陷促进了促纤维化表型，其特征是心房成纤维细胞中α-平滑肌肌动蛋白、纤连蛋白和I型胶原α表达增加，并加剧了压力超负荷小鼠的心房纤维化和心脏功能障碍。孟德尔随机化分析表明，较高的AHNAK表达对AF具有显著的保护作用，没有水平多效性的证据。

结论：本研究确定AHNAK作为HF患者中AF的区分性血浆生物标志物，并提示AHNAK缺陷是心房纤维化重构和AF发病机制的促进因素。需要在更大规模和前瞻性HF队列中进行外部验证，以确认AHNAK在AF风险分层和早期检测中的临床效用。
